references.text: The description of the ark of the covenant and how it was made, including the carrying poles mentioned in Num 4:6
Mentions taḥash skins (תַּחַשׁ) used as a covering, the same material as in Num 4:6
Taḥash skins used as a covering over the tabernacle, the same type of material that covers the ark
Instructions about the carrying poles (בַּדִּים) for the ark that were to be inserted into the rings
Blue color (תְּכֵלֶת) used in priestly garments, the same color as the fabric over the ark
Similar procedure for covering other holy objects with blue cloth and taḥash skins
Reference to the ark of the covenant and its holiness in the New Testament
